name: Orcs
prompt: Use the provided orc sheet ONLY as character/style reference. Redraw clean production sprites on TRANSPARENT background. EXACT FOUR ROWS x EIGHT COLUMNS with generous fully clear gutters. Same two characters, detailed fantasy game orcs, original fan-inspired LOTR woodland foes, NO extra or doubled limbs, no stray pixels, no translucent holes, solid crisp clean silhouettes and controlled shading, no blurry/grunge artifacts. Row1: the first green-gray leather scout orc running to the RIGHT, eight genuinely different complete run-cycle poses, same body scale and foot groundline. Row2: the stockier iron-helmet guard orc running RIGHT, eight poses. Row3: the SCOUT receives an arrow strike from the left, reacts and falls down in eight chronological poses, non-graphic defeated animation, no blood or wounds, no drawn arrow because game overlays arrow. Row4: the GUARD reacts and falls down the same way in eight chronological poses, no blood. Whole figures fully inside every cell, heads/shields/feet never cut off. Consistent face, clothes, perspective, anatomy and size. Clear separation between columns and rows, nothing touching edges. No background, text, grid lines, shadow floor or watermark.
